name: TemperatureService
description: Provides temperature, humidity, and pressure readings from DHT, BME280, and BMP280 sensors via /sensor/read. Supports C/F units.

actions.name: read
actions.description: Read temperature, humidity, and pressure from the sensor. Parameters: pin, type (DHT11, DHT21, DHT22, BME280, BMP280), unit (C/F).
